using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

const ll MOD1 = 998244353;
const ll MOD2 = 1000000007;

ll n, total;
int answer;
int ten[7];
int cnt[7][7];
vector<int> store[7][7];

void build(int prefix, int depth, int max_depth) {
    store[max_depth][depth].push_back(++total - prefix);
    if (depth == max_depth) return;
    for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {
        build(prefix * 10 + digit, depth + 1, max_depth);
    }
}

void brute_force(ll prefix, int depth) {
    if (prefix > n) return;
    ++total;
    answer = (answer + (total - prefix) / MOD1 - (total < prefix) + MOD2) % MOD2;
    for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {
        brute_force(prefix * 10 + digit, depth + 1);
    }
}

void solve_prefix(ll prefix, int depth) {
    if (depth != 6) {
        ++total;
        answer = (answer + (total - prefix) / MOD1 - (total < prefix) + MOD2) % MOD2;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {
            solve_prefix(prefix * 10 + digit, depth + 1);
        }
        return;
    }
    if (prefix == n) return;
    
    int k;
    ll val;
    for (k = 0, val = prefix; k <= 6 && val <= n; ++k) val *= 10;
    --k;
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i) {
        val = total - prefix * ten[i];
        answer = (answer + (val / MOD1 - (val < 0) + MOD2) * ten[i]) % MOD2;
        val = (val % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
        int pos = lower_bound(store[k][i].begin(), store[k][i].end(), MOD1 - val) - store[k][i].begin();
        answer = (answer + ten[i] - pos) % MOD2;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i) total += ten[i];
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n;
    ten[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) ten[i] = ten[i-1] * 10;
    
    for (int k = 0; k <= 6; ++k) {
        total = 0;
        build(0, 0, k);
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i) {
            sort(store[k][i].begin(), store[k][i].end());
        }
    }
    
    if (n < 1000000) {
        total = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; ++i) brute_force(i, 1);
    } else {
        ll temp_n = n;
        while (temp_n >= 1000000) temp_n /= 10;
        total = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; ++i) solve_prefix(i, 1);
    }
    
    cout << (int)((MOD2 - answer) * MOD1 % MOD2) << '\n';
    return 0;
